name: 🚁 Medicine Delivery Drone (Urban Medical Transit)
description: Autonomous aerial medical drone navigating hospital rooftop corridors — WASD flies forward, Space = Climb, C = Land, key 1 = ⚡ Wind Shear 45kt, key 2 = 📡 GPS Loss, key 3 = 🦅 Bird Strike, key 4 = 🔋 Thermal Throttle, key 5 = 🏗️ Crane Cable

base.default: An autonomous medical delivery quadcopter drone with cyan LED status lights carrying a refrigerated medical container labeled CRITICAL MEDICINE DELIVERY. The world contains EXACTLY ONE modern hospital tower on the left at a fixed position AND EXACTLY ONE rooftop helipad straight ahead at a fixed position AND EXACTLY ONE medical research facility on the right at a fixed position. Morning golden sunlight reflecting on glass facades, clear sky, urban airspace corridor.

default.static: Third-person view from behind the medical delivery drone, its chassis and medical box centred in frame at constant size — never a first-person view. Neither drone nor camera moves; look-input is the only camera motion, arcing around the stationary hovering drone while held.
default.dynamic: Strict third-person chase view from close behind and slightly above the medical delivery drone, its chassis filling frame centre — never first-person. It holds a fixed rear position and tracks behind the drone; look-input becomes the drone banking and changing flight heading.

default.static: The medical delivery drone hovers stationary in place at 60 meters altitude, carbon-fiber rotors spinning stably with cyan navigation lights on standby.
default.dynamic: The medical delivery drone advances smoothly forward through the urban air corridor, its rotors humming rapidly as the hospital towers and rooftop pads glide steadily past beneath.

events.name: ⚡ Wind Shear & Severe 45kt Microburst
events.detail: A sudden 45-knot crosswind microburst strikes the drone from the left, forcing rapid differential motor thrust compensation to maintain heading.

events.name: 📡 GPS Dropout & Urban Canyon Drift
events.detail: Satellite GPS signal drops in the urban canyon; the drone switches to visual optical flow odometry, drifting slightly before locking visual features.

events.name: 🦅 Bird Strike Trajectory Crossing
events.detail: A flock of birds crosses directly through the flight path ahead, triggering an emergency altitude climb and evasive maneuver.

events.name: 🔋 Cell Voltage Sag & Thermal Throttling
events.detail: Battery voltage sags under high draw; rotor power throttles to 70% cruise limit, activating yellow warning telemetry.

events.name: 🏗️ Tower Crane Steel Cable Occlusion
events.detail: A thin steel construction crane cable appears directly in the LiDAR point cloud, requiring an immediate 90-degree yaw avoidance replan.

scene.jumpPrompt: The medical drone commands full collective motor thrust, climbing rapidly +15 meters vertically to clear low roof obstructions.
scene.crouchPrompt: The medical drone cuts forward airspeed and initiates an automated stabilized descent toward the hospital rooftop landing pad.
scene.standPrompt: The medical drone arrests its descent, restoring standard 60-meter cruising altitude and forward airspeed.
